status_meaning.scored: a validation run exists and its scores are in cases/{id}/validation.json
status_meaning.running: the solve is in progress; no scores yet
status_meaning.not comparable: the engine cannot produce the measured quantity at the measured location: OpenLB at the resolution this hardware runs, FluidX3D without a ground wall function; the measurement behind each is on the Validation page

results.quantity: U, V, W and k at the 15 points of the tunnel's WD 180 run over the tunnel's U_R = 4.08 m/s (measured) and over the solved speed at the reference mast (modelled; U_R is defined at the mast), and the dimensionless concentration c* = C/c0 (c0 = q/(U_R H_R^2) = 132.5 ppm) against the model's c U_R H_R^2/Q for turbulent Schmidt number 0.3; the 18-run field campaign is compared as well
results.normalisation: U, V, W and k at the 15 points over the tunnel's U_R = 4.08 m/s on the measurement and over the solved speed at the reference mast on the model (U_R is defined at the mast), k over U_R^2; c* = C/c0 (c0 = q/(U_R H_R^2) = 132.5 ppm) against the model's c U_R H_R^2/Q (H_R = 0.068 m x 600, Q = 1 kg/s) for turbulent Schmidt number 0.3, with one detection limit of 10^-3 of the largest measured value; hit rate D = 0.25, W = 0.05 in those units; the Schmidt numbers are three runs on one flow
notes: One heading and one steady solve: WD 180, the only heading with measured velocities. The tunnel's WD 175 scored as a model of its WD 180 gives R +0.93, FAC2 0.73, FB +0.40, its WD 185 R +0.98, FAC2 0.80, FB -0.12, and the mean of the two R +1.00, FAC2 1.00, FB +0.11; 8 of the 15 points change by more than a factor of two between WD 175 and WD 185 (computed from the pairs).
The turbulent Schmidt number does not change the flow: the three runs of this case are one solve with three passive tracers, so U, V, W and k are the same in all three and only c* differs.

U_R is the solved speed at the reference mast, 4.686 m/s, which is 1.19 of the tabulated inlet's speed at the mast's elevation (3.934 m/s) and 1.15 of the tunnel's 4.08 m/s. Over the imposed speed c* scores FB +1.48 and over 4.08 m/s FB +1.46, against +1.40 over the solved speed.

Model set-up: a cylinder of 540 m radius and 240 m height on the terrain sheet; the tabulated approach profile over a smooth floor; no counterpart of the tunnel's side walls (at ±360 m) and 600 m ceiling (blockage 5 %). The 6 mm outlet is 3.6 m at 1:600; the source here is a 4 m cube on the ground (a zone of 20 cells, 2 m surface cells), 1 kg/s as a volume source with no exit momentum. The 15 points are 3 m above the ground.

Mean c* over the three points nearest the source: 2.52 (tunnel), 0.26 / 0.11 / 0.05 (model, Sct 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.7); over the two far downwind points: 0.21 (tunnel), 0.11 / 0.10 / 0.09 (model). Peak c*: 3.04 (tunnel), 1.27 / 1.37 / 1.38 (model); 3 / 3 / 3 of the five highest points are shared with the tunnel.
The tunnel's three points nearest the source carry about 12 times its two far downwind ones; the modelled plume carries less, and Sct 0.7 reverses the order.

Controls on the same solution: the points turned 180° about the source score R -0.05, FAC2 0.07, FB +2.00 (14 of the 15 lie in the fluid; the model's mean over those points is 7.3e-06 against 0.186 at the real ones), and the points mirrored across the plume axis score R +0.68, FAC2 0.47, FB +0.32 (the real points: R +0.41, FAC2 0.20, FB +1.40).

The tracer goes downwind: the model's mean over the points turned 180° about the source is far below its mean at the real points. The mirrored points score above the real points because the modelled plume is displaced sideways against the tunnel's. The tunnel's neighbouring headings WD 175 and WD 185 are the noise floor of a single heading.

Field campaign (18 runs): the 10 runs within 10° of 180 at 3 m/s or more, each with its own U_R and q and H_R = 41 m as the cleaned table states (the scores divide by 40.8 m, a 1 % difference). The model against the field's geometric mean scores R +0.46, FAC2 0.07, FB +1.01, and lies inside the field's minimum-maximum range at 2 of 15 points; the tunnel's WD 180 against the same mean scores R +0.98, FAC2 0.60, FB -0.59; the spread of the field at point 1 is a factor of 4.5.

The velocity at the 15 points: the mean U/U_R is 0.026 modelled against 0.164 measured. FB is not defined for V and W (their means are not both positive); V correlates at R +0.73 and flipping its sign gives -0.73.

The solve ran to its 3000-iteration limit with the residualControl unmet (no 'solution converged' line); the initial residuals at the last iteration were U_x 6.1e-04, U_z 6.9e-04, p 1.0e-04, epsilon 1.9e-02, k 1.6e-04 and the tracers 8.1e-06 to 1.1e-05. checkMesh: Mesh OK. 1,394,053 cells. The tracer probe prints seven significant digits; a probe at six decimals moved no c* value by more than 0.003.

metric_meaning.MeanObserved: mean of the measured, normalised quantity
metric_meaning.MeanPredicted: mean of the modelled, normalised quantity
metric_meaning.Fb: fractional bias, 2 (mean_obs - mean_pred) / (mean_obs + mean_pred); positive = model low
metric_meaning.Fac2: fraction of points within a factor of two (harsh near zero for sign-changing V and W)
metric_meaning.HitRate: fraction of points within D = 0.25 relative or W = 0.05 U_H absolute
metric_meaning.GeometricPairs: pairs with both values positive (used for Mg/Vg)
metric_meaning.null: a metric that is undefined for the data (for example Mg and Vg when no pair has both values positive; Fb, Nmse and Nad of a signed velocity component of Case H or I whose observed and predicted means are not both positive)

figures.caption: Case M, measurement points: A near field, within 100 m of the release point; B mid field, 100 to 300 m from the release point; C far field, beyond 300 m. Positions in metres, full scale. Star: release point; R: reference point; dotted circles: 100 m and 300 m from the release point.

Case M, OpenFOAM 12 (realizable k-ε), WD 180: measured against modelled U, V, W and k over the tunnel's U_R and the solved speed at the mast, and the dimensionless concentration c* = C/c0 at turbulent Schmidt numbers 0.3, 0.5 and 0.7 (log axes show the positive pairs within eight decades only); the last panel is the tunnel's own WD 175 and WD 185 against its WD 180, the noise floor of a single heading. Dots take the colour of the group of points they belong to: the letters and colours of the layout figure of the case.

Case M, OpenFOAM 12, WD 180: log₁₀ of c* at the 15 points on the plan of the campus (north up; the arrow is the wind), the tunnel and the three Schmidt numbers on one scale; a point below 10⁻³ (or zero) is open. The star is the gas source and the square the reference mast.

Case M, OpenFOAM 12: the solved field on pedestrian level of the campus (z = 35.5 m above the tunnel floor), tunnel WD 180. a: u; b: u with iso-lines every 0.1 and the edge of the reversed flow (u = 0) dashed; c: the in-plane speed with streamlines. Each dot is a measured point, coloured by its measured value on the panel's scale.

results.pairs_columns: point_id (the tunnel's); x, y, z in m (the release's frame, full scale: x north, y west, z above the tunnel floor); U, V, W, speed (the magnitude of the velocity vector) and k at WD 180, measured (_meas: the cleaned workbook values over the tunnel's U_R = 4.08 m/s, k over U_R^2) and modelled (_model: over the solved speed at the reference mast, 4.686 m/s; U is the case's +y, V = -U_x, W = U_z); cstar_meas, the measured C/c0 at WD 180 (c0 = 132.514 ppm), cstar_wd175 and cstar_wd185, the same at the tunnel's neighbouring headings, and cstar_sct03 / _sct05 / _sct07, the modelled c* = c U_R H_R^2 / Q (H_R = 40.8 m, Q = 1 kg/s) for turbulent Schmidt numbers 0.3, 0.5 and 0.7; cstar_<sct>_turned180 and cstar_<sct>_mirrored, the model's c* at the 15 points turned 180 degrees about the source and mirrored across the plume axis (3 m above the ground or a roof there; empty where the control point is not in the fluid); cstar_field_geomean, _min and _max, the field campaign's geometric mean, minimum and maximum of c* over its 10 runs within 10 degrees of 180 at 3 m/s or more (each run's own U_R and q, H_R = 41 m)
results.reproduce: Eddy3D fixture Eddy3DCli.Tests/Validation/TestAijCaseMContainerE2E (WD 180, the default) (TPU Atsugi campus, 1:600, tunnel WD 180, turbulent Schmidt number 0.3; OpenFOAM 12 realizable k-ε, numerics level 3, 3000 iterations, 1,394,053 cells, solved 2026-10-18); figures validation/plot_cases_fm_openfoam.py; scores recomputed from the pairs by validation/dispersion_metrics.py; the SHA-256 of every file the snapshot was read from is in its results file, under `sources`
